connector.name: FFMPEG API
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP tools for FFmpeg-style video and audio processing through FFMPEG API.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.ffmpegapi.net over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hifarrer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: FFMPEG API key for authenticating MCP requests.
